description: This C# source file defines the class 'AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage<TState>' which implements transactional state storage methods using Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for loading, storing, and managing transactional state, along with internal batch operation handling, logging, and querying logic.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage<TState>
classes.description: A class implementing transactional state storage backed by Azure Table Storage, supporting load and store operations with concurrency control and batch processing.

classes.name: BatchOperation
classes.description: Internal class managing batched table transactions for efficiency, including adding, flushing, and conflict handling.

classes.name: StatesLogRecord
classes.description: A struct used for structured logging of state entities, with overridden ToString for concise representation.

classes.name: KeyEntity
classes.description: Represents the key entity in Azure Table for transactional state metadata, inherits from TableEntity.

classes.name: StateEntity
classes.description: Represents individual state records stored in Azure Table, with serialization and deserialization logic.

classes.name: PendingTransactionState<TState>
classes.description: Structured data representing a pending transaction's state, including identifiers and timestamps.

classes.name: TransactionalStateMetaData
classes.description: Metadata for transactional state, serialized as JSON.

classes.name: ParticipantId
classes.description: Class representing participant identity in transactions, used in transaction management.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the current transactional state, recovery info, and pending transactions from Azure Tables.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores and commits the provided transactional state and metadata, handling concurrency with ETag checks.

methods.name: FindState
methods.description: Binary search helper to locate a state by sequence ID within the sorted 'states' collection.

methods.name: ReadKey
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the key entity from Azure Table storage.

methods.name: ReadStates
methods.description: Asynchronously reads all state entities in the specified partition and orders them by sequence ID.
